provenance.citation: Winograd, T. (1972). Understanding Natural Language. Academic Press. SHRDLU Blocks World: symbolic scene parsing of polyhedra (cubes, pyramids, wedges) with support relationships. find_clear_object identifies the topmost unblocked block.
provenance.locus: Chapter 2: The Blocks World domain — scene with cube A on table, pyramid B on A, wedge C on table. B is the clear object because nothing rests on it.
provenance.notes: parse_polyhedra reads facts where key=shape, value=object_id. Facts 'supported_by:B'='A' record support relationships. Objects sorted by id (A,B,C). find_clear_object iterates in that order: A is blocked by B, B is clear. selected='B'.

expected.scene_description: Cube A on table, pyramid B on top of A (supported_by A), wedge C on table. B is the first clear object in alphabetical scan (A is blocked by B, B has nothing on it).
expected.algorithm_outcome: AutoinstinctVision identifies B as the first clear (unblocked) polyhedron in the blocks-world scene via symbolic support-relation traversal (SHRDLU/Winograd 1972 domain).
